summary: Harden endpoint observation contract and publish optimization plan

delivery.outcome: The endpoint observation contract rejects credential-bearing URLs before DNS and does not retain credentials in process-local observations while publishing the bounded optimization plan.
nonGoals: No change to endpoint runtime behavior beyond the existing ticket-024 contract.
No secret access or persistent endpoint cache.
No external DNS, GitHub or provider mutation outside protected delivery.

architecture.decision: Keep the existing endpoint parser as the credential boundary and lock its no-DNS/no-cache behavior with a focused regression test.
architecture.rollback: Revert the focused regression test and bounded plan documentation.
